title: プロジェクトデザイン実践（実験）(機械工学科)
subtitle: Design Project / Implementing and Operating
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal:
-To gain skills to verify hypotheses or solution concept with logical approaches.
-To understand phenomena, objects and events quantitatively with high credibility based on data science.
-To reliably find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, events.
-To deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain basic skills to credibly and smoothly conduct verification activities.
-To have an image of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
advice:
-Learn how to proceed with the hypothesis testing process. Learn the process of verifying the effectiveness/acceptability of methods aimed at solving problems.
-Learn "data processing skills" necessary for data collection, organization, analysis, hypothesis, visualization, and reporting.
-Students will learn "skills to advance the verification process" and "basic skills of verification activities" from hypothesis planning to verification based on data science.
-The Department of Mechanical Engineering has the theme of "heat sink," which is a heat dissipation mechanism for engines, etc., as the basis of thermal engineering.
-Performance has been verified with experimental tests and evidence-based prototypes.
-Based on this validation, you will learn data collection skills, validation process progress skills, and validation factor solution proposals.
[Activity report]
Regardless of the effectiveness of the solution proposal, the results of the project activities are compiled into a project report and presented in a poster session or verbally.
requiredKnowledge:
Comprehensive experience in "investigation of information", "how to put out ideas", "experimental methods", and "problem discovery / problem solving / team activity / logical verification activity" acquired in Project Design Introduction I/II. In order to make use of these, it is necessary to review these items.
At the same time, students must pay attention to the utilization and improvement of learning CAD skills in mechanical drawing.
This course uses Yumekobo machine tools, so be sure to obtain a license.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts.
2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize information.
3) To find and understand features, characteristics, and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events based on data science
4) To communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
5) To smoothly conduct verification activities.
6) To become aware of your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers.
achievementLevels.standard:
1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts with guidance.
2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize the information with guidance from the instructor.
3) To find and understand characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, etc. based on data with guidance.
4) To share acquired information to third person.
5) To smoothly conduct verification activities with guidance from the instructor.
6) To recognize your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers with guidance.
